task.title: Replace feedback/documentation with decision build orchestration
task.summary: Introduce the vNext decision_build path as a clean replacement for routine feedback/documentation compiler code, with direct decision-to-planning handoff and no backwards-compatibility wrappers in package source.

goal.outcome: CodeWiki uses decision_build as the clean semantic intent-to-knowledge handoff and planning consumes decision_build directly.
acceptance: Decision build kind/schema is represented in domain/application/adapters as the semantic build path.
Decision orchestration supports proposal and accepted modes with no canonical writes before approval.
Accepted decision artifacts record approved rows, row-to-KB mappings, product/system propagation direction, assumptions, risks, and downstream planning questions.
Planning builds consume source_decision_build directly; routine source_documentation_build requirements are removed from package source.
Feedback/documentation compiler loops are removed from primary package source/tests rather than kept as compatibility wrappers.
non_goals: Do not implement graph diagram-ref audits or gate fast paths in this task.
Do not consolidate all public workflow tools in this task.
Do not implement TASK-002 diagram migration beyond decision_build refs needed by this task.
verification: Run typecheck and focused build/tool smoke tests.
Validate decision-build traceability with a new or updated smoke test.
Run CodeWiki alignment and stale-reference audits.

loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from CodeWiki source refs; agents may refresh context when chat is noisy, stale, or token-heavy.

validation.reason: Implementation validation must not reuse builder thought context and must cite checked content proof.

next_loop.reason: The next gateway must independently validate implementation evidence and cite checked content proof.

summary: Update TASK-001 implementation build after fixing tool-context session boundary compaction regression.

evidence: Changed regression test so tool-context context-refresh uses a compact function that fails if invoked.
Asserted result action is platform-limited, status remains queued, and workflow-efficiency records zero session boundaries used.
notes: Regression reproduced by prior session: tool result disappeared after codewiki_session_handoff triggered ctx.compact.
Relevant smoke, typecheck, package smoke, and full npm test pass after fix.
tester.boundary: derive tests or test-design evidence before code changes where practical

evidence: Removed ctx.compact call from executeSessionHandoffFromTool for context-refresh/context-reset.
Added contextRefreshToolResult with explicit reason and next safe action.
Updated Pi tool guidance and schema description to prevent future agents/tools from assuming automatic compaction.
notes: Do not call codewiki_session_handoff again from this session for validation handoff; use direct validation/reporting or explicit external flow until fixed version is installed.
builder.boundary: change code until tests, roadmap acceptance, and required checks pass

Asserted result action is platform-limited, status remains queued, and workflow-efficiency records zero session boundaries used.
code_change_evidence: Removed ctx.compact call from executeSessionHandoffFromTool for context-refresh/context-reset.
Added contextRefreshToolResult with explicit reason and next safe action.
Updated Pi tool guidance and schema description to prevent future agents/tools from assuming automatic compaction.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Tool-context codewiki_session_handoff with context-refresh/context-reset must not compact before returning a visible result.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: src/application/tools/session-handoff.ts now returns a platform-limited staged result for context_refresh/context_reset without calling ctx.compact; tests assert compact would fail if called.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: No slash command or editor/user command workaround is surfaced for tool-context boundaries.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: executeSessionHandoffFromTool still returns auto_queue=false and no command; session-handoff smoke asserts queueSessionHandoffFollowUp remains false.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Command-context compatibility executor can still perform explicit context-refresh when invoked by host command context.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: tests/smoke/session-handoff.test.mjs keeps runSessionHandoffCommand context-refresh coverage and asserts command-context compact instructions are passed.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Docs/tool prompts describe the platform-limited staged behavior instead of automatic tool-context compaction.

closure_brief.user_intent: Prevent codewiki_session_handoff tool-context context-refresh from compacting the active session before the tool result is visible.
implemented_changes: Tool-context context-refresh/context-reset now returns a platform-limited staged result without calling ctx.compact.
Regression smoke asserts compact is not called and the staged handoff remains queued.
Pi tool prompt/schema and CodeWiki system docs now warn against compacting during tool execution.

validation: codewiki_audit warning: only generated dirty warnings

acceptance_evidence: Stale-reference/file-structure/generated-parity/task/package audits pass; only generated dirty warnings remain.
non_goals_preserved: Did not remove the internal /wiki-session-handoff command-context executor.
Did not auto-queue slash commands or ask users to run compatibility commands.
remaining_risks: Actual compaction is no longer performed from tool context; explicit host-native context controls are needed when compaction itself is required.

risks: Tool-context context-refresh now stages refs but does not perform compaction; callers needing actual context compaction must use explicit command-context/host-native controls outside tool execution.
